~$50B run rate in Sept 2026 per FT/Reuters, about $20B below earlier company signals.

$65B run rate (Axios, Aug 2026). The S-1/A shows Q3 2026 revenue of $16.956B (about $67.8B annualized). Unverified reports claim more than $80B.

Above $50B after its first outside round (Jun 2026). Unverified secondary claims of $74B exist.

Grok 4.5 scored 54 and Kimi K3 scored 57 on the pre-v5 Artificial Analysis index. Those scores are not comparable to v5 and are not used.
